1. Rotate GitHub token
2. Rotate Render key
3. Rotate AWS keys if still used
4. Rotate Supabase service-role key if exposed
5. Change owner password
6. Save new secrets in encrypted provider environments
7. Push the zero-Rork commit to GitHub
8. Run CI until green
9. Deploy API and worker
10. Verify all SHAs match
11. Log into IVX as owner
12. Approve autonomous QA
13. Approve autonomous deployment
14. Verify replay rejection
15. Run clean-room build
16. Final zero-Rork audit
